provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.math.overline.braces against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lint.rs:check_latex, test:mdbook-dada/tests/latex.rs:overbars_require_a_preceding_brace_and_following_literal_space, test:mdbook-dada/tests/latex.rs:grouped_overbars_and_other_control_words_are_allowed, test:mdbook-dada/tests/latex.rs:diagnostics_count_source_lines_including_unicode_and_crlf, test:mdbook-dada/tests/latex.rs:book_build_checks_math_directives_examples_and_literal_tex, test:mdbook-dada/tests/latex.rs:all_book_markdown_follows_latex_conventions. check_latex uses a raw-source regex for the exact control word, requiring an immediately preceding brace and literal ASCII space after it. Tests distinguish tabs/newlines/nonbreaking spaces and longer names, verify Unicode/CRLF line counts, apply the lint in nested book chapters/literal samples and scan all md files recursively. The prose correctly limits this to adjacency rather than TeX parsing. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
